qualifiers: S08 uses actual Azure index evidence and custom indexed graph, not native agentic KB or native relationship graph
S09 is a sourced Azure-indexed experiment, not native topic materialization

limits.S01: App substring baseline uses a complete <=2,000-record reviewed synthetic index snapshot with bounded pagination and separately metered pages; fulltext synonym configuration checked against index schema.
limits.S02: Verified server-side Entra Azure OpenAI corpus/query embeddings use text-embedding-3-small@1, 1536 dimensions. Integrated Search vectorization remains a separately configured alternative. Never send a Search key to the model origin.
limits.S03: Identical hard category/price filters. Stable Search API independent of pinned KB preview.
limits.S04: Actual shared hybrid retrieval and semanticQuery-only L2 succeeded over exact candidate IDs. A reviewed searchable keyword ID field supplies nonzero L1 relevance via a full Lucene ID query and strict ID filter; search=* filter-only semantic ranking is not used. Exact IDs/content and reranker scores are checked, otherwise enhanced fails without fallback. Schema cache hits are not dispatched attempts.
limits.S05: Identical London, stock and price/category filters; facets are service returned, not fabricated.
limits.S06: All five reviewed scoring profiles are schema-checked against their expected function/field types. Distance and tag parameter names/values are server-configured. Dynamic live weights unavailable; Sample supports weights. First-stage scoring, no semantic-stage promise.
limits.S07: Replacement uses native single-index agentic Documents Search 2026-11-01-preview on the baseline's same public-scoped support index. No KB Retrieve, external planner, queryLanguage or incompatible classic options. Real canary returned 402: Free Knowledge Retrieval cannot use Microsoft Retriever 1. Paid Standard plan approval pending. Same answer model/instructions remain independent; one cold index-schema read plus five warm embedding/retrieval/answer attempts are metered. Bounded debug counts, termination and supplied usage only; raw subqueries excluded. HTTP206 or early termination remains partial. No classic/KB/Sample fallback; existing KB retained untouched.
limits.S08: Native Foundry IQ entity-graph search (docs/search.graph, 2026-11-01-preview) over the English Zava graph, with hydrated passage provenance. GQL comes only from the curated server-side preset allowlist; plain retrieval is hybrid search with the semantic ranker.
limits.S09: Native Foundry IQ topic-balanced retrieval (topicGraph balanced vs none, no semantic ranker) and corpus themes read from the native topic index for the English Zava dataset.
limits.S10: Approved East US 2 CU resource actually executed GA Read/Layout on the same canonical PDF; actual page/table/cell outputs indexed with analyzer/operation/hash provenance. Native inch polygons preserved. Headers are separate paragraphs; ordinal column mapping is disclosed. DCD796 13/40/13 and adjacent DCD797 16/38/13 verified on page 2. Old deterministic example stays custom. No arbitrary upload/durable processing.
limits.S11: Actual Vision binary vectorizeImage 2024-02-01, pinned 2023-04-15 model, 1024 dimensions for three corpus PNGs and query image. Reviewed manifest hash, safe original PNG gallery links, per-record compatible metadata. Ephemeral JPEG/PNG/WebP <=40 KiB, MIME/signature/base64 checks; no URLs/persistence/jobs/text-vector substitute. Four cold HTTP attempts. Entra-only account; AML unverified. Image Analysis 4.0 deprecated, retirement September 25 2028. Sample retains fixed illustrative reference.
